Joshua Kushner’s Thrive Holdings Agrees to Acquire ADT in $7.6 Billion Deal

30 Oct 2026, 05:17 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Tech Desk · Source: www.theverge.com

Key takeaways Acquisition Details and Timeline Thrive Holdings, led by Joshua Kushner, has entered into an agreement to acquire home security provider ADT in an all-cash transaction valued at $7.6 billion. The transaction will result in ADT becoming a privately held company. Accord

Acquisition Details and Timeline

Thrive Holdings, led by Joshua Kushner, has entered into an agreement to acquire home security provider ADT in an all-cash transaction valued at $7.6 billion. The transaction will result in ADT becoming a privately held company. According to the announcement, the deal is projected to close during the first quarter of 2027.

Joshua Kushner founded Thrive Holdings last year as an offshoot of his venture capital firm, Thrive Capital Management. The firm focuses on acquiring traditional businesses—such as IT and accounting services—and integrating artificial intelligence into their operational workflows.

ADT's Technology Partnerships

While ADT maintains its own standalone home security operations, the company has established significant commercial partnerships within the consumer technology sector. ADT technicians are authorized to sell and install Google Nest devices, alongside Apple's recent lineup of smart home products.

In the official press release addressing the transaction, ADT CEO Jim DeVries stated, “With Thrive Holdings’ long-term capital and technology expertise, ADT will gain new opportunities to accelerate innovation, enhance the customer experience and bring greater peace of mind to even more homes and businesses.”

Practical Implications and Analysis

For current and future ADT customers, the pending acquisition introduces potential changes centered around technological integration, particularly given Thrive Holdings' strategic focus on applying AI to traditional business models. However, because the transaction is still pending regulatory approvals and standard closing conditions, daily operations remain unchanged for the time being.

What Is Confirmed Versus Unknown

Confirmed:

  • Thrive Holdings is acquiring ADT in an all-cash deal valued at $7.6 billion.
  • The transaction will take ADT private.
  • The expected closing date is the first quarter of 2027.
  • ADT currently maintains partnerships involving Google Nest and Apple smart home products.

Unknown:

  • Specific details regarding how AI integration will directly affect consumer-facing security systems have not yet been detailed.
  • Final regulatory approval timelines prior to the 2027 closing date remain subject to standard review processes.

Readers can verify the original announcement and monitor further updates by visiting the official report on [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1022295/joshua-kushner-thrive-holdings-adt-acquisition).
